title: Public Records Request – Columbiana Foundry Company, Columbiana, Ohio

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Public Records Request – Columbiana Foundry Company, Columbiana, Ohio
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This request concerns the facility's operations and physical plant, particularly during the period January 1, 1978, through December 31, 1984. Please include records created before or after that period to the extent they document historical site conditions, equipment, building materials, renovations, demolition, or asbestos-containing materials.

Please search electronic and available historical paper records, including records maintained by the relevant EPA district and air-pollution-control programs, for the following:

Asbestos surveys, asbestos-containing material inventories, bulk sampling results, laboratory analyses, asbestos abatement plans, and abatement completion reports.
Asbestos-related demolition or renovation notifications, including notifications submitted under the National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAP), inspection reports, compliance records, and related correspondence.
Air permits, permit applications, facility descriptions, inspection reports, and records concerning the installation, replacement, modification, or removal of furnaces, cupolas, induction furnaces, heat-treatment furnaces, boilers, exhaust systems, and associated industrial equipment.
Facility site plans, building floor plans, equipment layouts, engineering drawings, construction or renovation documents, and records identifying the location or removal of thermal insulation or other potentially asbestos-containing building materials.
Environmental assessments, hazardous-material surveys, site investigations, sampling reports, remediation records, and communications concerning asbestos or other hazardous building materials at the facility.
Any historical records associated with the company's 1972 cupola-to-induction-furnace replacement project, including permit applications, project descriptions, equipment specifications, and related agency correspondence.

Please search under the names “The Columbiana Foundry Company,” “Columbiana Foundry Company,” and “Columbiana Foundry,” as well as the physical address and any historical facility identifiers located during your search.

If any responsive records are held by another agency or district office, please identify the appropriate custodian or forward this request if permitted. If records are available for electronic delivery, please provide them in electronic form. If no responsive records are located, please identify the databases, offices, and historical record collections searched, to the extent possible.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kevin LaMarca

title: City of Berkeley Euthanization of Griz

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: City of Berkeley Euthanization of Griz
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All documents pertaining to the euthanization of a dog named "Griz" in the control of the City of Berkeley, from August 1, 2026 until October 12, 2026

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records regarding this agency acquisition and use of BriefCam, video analytics software sold by Milestone Systems (https://www.milestonesys.com/products/briefcam/). 

1. All contracts and other agreements between this agency and Milestone Systems/BriefCam, including all amendments and exhibits. 
2. All manuals, handbooks, policies, and other directives on the use of the BriefCam system. This includes all information on how to use the system itself and all materials on the appropriate use of this system by employees of this agency.
3. All user audit and access logs reflecting access of or actions taken within the BriefCam system. Please provide these materials for the period from when the system was first made functional through the date on which this request is processed. Please provide these logs as a .csv or .xls file, if possible. 
4. A copy of the metadata associated with all alerts generated by this agency’s BriefCam system for the period from January 1, 2025 through the date on which this request is processed. This metadata should include all available information, including username, event, time stamp, a session ID, the associated IP address, and a description of the activity. Please provide this metadata as a .csv or .xls file, if possible. 

This request is being made by a journalistic researcher. It is being made for research purposes, not commercial ones. Please assess fees in accordance with provisions for media requesters. In the event that this agency decides to charge this requester fees not to exceed the actual cost of reproducing the records, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

Please fulfill this request electronically, preferably by e-mail attachment, if available.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response within the statutorily-mandated timeframe. 

Sincerely, 

Judah Trease
